name: team-task-manager-monorepo
description: Futuristic Team Task Manager with secure RBAC, Kanban, and Analytics

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('npm', ['start'], { cwd: 'backend', shell: true, stdio: 'inherit' }); spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: 'frontend', shell: true, stdio: 'inherit' });"
